exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Welcoming a New Classmate
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Did you hear that a new student is joining our class tomorrow?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Yes, I did. Moving to a new school can be really hard.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Exactly. I still remember how lonely I felt on my own first day.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Let's do something kind. We could show her around at lunch.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Great idea. I can introduce her to the football club too.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: And I'll save her a seat right next to us in class.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Perfect. One small gesture might make her whole week.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: You're right. Let's make sure she feels truly welcome.

exercises.translation_cn: A 听说明天有新同学转来;B 说转学很不容易;A 还记得自己第一天有多孤单;两人决定做点好事:午饭时带她参观、把她介绍给足球社、给她在班里留座位;希望一个小举动能让她感到被欢迎。

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 A Tip for Making Friends
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip for making new friends.
Do not wait for other people to come to you first.
A warm smile and a friendly hello can open the door to a new friendship.
When you meet someone new, ask about their hobbies and really listen to the answer.
Small acts of kindness, like sharing a snack or lending a pen, help people feel close to you.
Remember, every good friend was once a stranger.
exercises.translation_cn: 一个交朋友的小贴士:别等别人先来找你;一个温暖的微笑和友好的问候就能打开新友谊的大门;遇到新朋友时问问他们的爱好并认真倾听;像分享零食、借支笔这样的小善举能拉近彼此;记住,每个好朋友最初都是陌生人。

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 An Interview on Friendship
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: What does true friendship really mean to you?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: To me, a true friend is someone who stays when times are hard.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: So you agree that a friend in need is a friend indeed?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Absolutely. Almost anyone can share the good times with you.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: How do you keep a friendship strong over the years?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: By being honest and always making time for each other.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: That's wonderful. Thank you for sharing your thoughts.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: My pleasure. Good friends really are one of life's greatest gifts.

exercises.translation_cn: 采访友谊话题:B 认为真朋友是在困难时仍留在你身边的人;同意'患难见真情';因为顺境时几乎谁都能陪你;维系友谊靠诚实和总愿为彼此花时间;最后说好朋友是人生最珍贵的礼物之一。

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 Being a Good Listener
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: One of the best ways to be a good friend is to be a good listener.
When your friend is talking, give them your full attention instead of looking at your phone.
Try not to break in before they have finished speaking.
If you are not sure what they mean, repeat their idea in your own words to check.
Showing that you truly understand makes your friend feel valued.
Good listening is a quiet but very powerful gift.
exercises.translation_cn: 做好朋友的最佳方式之一是做个好的倾听者:朋友说话时全神贯注,别看手机;别在他们说完前打断;不确定意思时用自己的话复述以确认;让对方感到你真的理解,他就会觉得被重视;善于倾听是一份安静而强大的礼物。

exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: You look really down today. Is everything all right?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Not really. I've been so lonely here that I'm thinking of leaving school.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Please don't drop out. Give it a little more time.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: But I don't have a single friend in this place.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: You do now. Come and hang out with us this weekend.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Really? You'd actually want me to join you?

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Of course. A new place always feels hard at first.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Thank you. Maybe I'll stay and give it another chance.

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 Cherish Your Friends
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: We do not always notice how much our friends mean to us until they are gone.
A good friend listens when we are sad, laughs with us when we are happy, and stands by us when others walk away.
Yet we often forget to say a simple thank-you.
Why not tell your friends today how much you really care?
A few kind words cost nothing, but they can make a friendship last a lifetime.
exercises.translation_cn: 我们往往要等朋友离开才意识到他们有多重要;好朋友在我们难过时倾听,在我们快乐时同笑,在别人离开时仍守在身边;可我们常忘了说一句简单的谢谢;何不今天就告诉朋友你有多在乎?几句善言不花一分钱,却能让友谊持续一生;珍惜你拥有的朋友。
